name: Modal
how_you_get_it: Create a Modal account. The Starter plan includes a monthly compute grant.
trap: The grant is monthly and the unused part voids at the reset. Not spending it is pure loss, not saving.

balance.why_not_api: The remaining monthly grant is shown in the dashboard. Checked 2026-08-21.

coverage.note: the Starter grant is spent against compute time.
